entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi Alex. I'm calling about a return for a helmet I purchased a little while back.
I can certainly help with that. Do you have your order number handy?

Thank you. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the VeloFit Aero helmet, delivered on September 17th. That was 81 days ago. To move forward, could you tell me a bit more about the issue? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?
It's a preference issue. The color wasn't quite what I expected when I saw it in person. The box is still unopened, so it's in perfect condition.

I understand completely. Let me just quickly confirm our policy for you. One moment... Okay, good news. Since the helmet was delivered 81 days ago, it's well within our 90-day return window. I can go ahead and approve that return for you.
Excellent. So that's a full refund?
That's correct. A full refund to your original payment method once we receive the item. I can email you a pre-paid shipping label right now.

That sounds good. Now, since I'll be placing another order for a different helmet – you know, safety is my top priority – and I've had to hold onto this one for a bit, would you be able to provide a small discount code for my next purchase for the inconvenience?

I appreciate you asking, and I'm happy you're choosing us for your next purchase. However, our policy doesn't allow for discount codes on preference-based returns. I can assure you the return shipping is completely free, and I'll get that label sent over immediately to make it as smooth as possible.
Fair enough, I thought I'd check. That's fine. Please send over the label. Thank you for your help, Alex.
You're very welcome. The email with the label is on its way to you now. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
